anya: Noticing peregrine-int4 canary: ~1.7% funcall parse errors. Looks like NDJSON objects are getting merged or cut when kv-cache + streaming are on.

frank: any sanitized examples? streaming concat or truncation?

anya: two quick fails pasted below. both reproduced on local with kvcache+continuous-streaming:

1) glued objects:
{"id":1,"tool":{"name":"extract","args":{}}}
{"id":1,"tool":{"name":"label","args":{}}}

2) truncated suffix cuts off closing braces at token boundary. parser raises EOF error.

liu: try toggles: --disable-kvcache and --disable-streaming to isolate. Also enable token-boundary logs (last 32 token ids).

anya: ran quick probes: disable-streaming -> failures 0.02%. disable-kvcache -> 0.3%. so interaction is streaming+kvcache.

ops-bot: CI digest 2025-03-20: peregrine-int4 streaming ON + kvcache ON, n=8000 pass 98.3% fail 1.7%.

frank: short-term: deploy a feature-flagged postprocess sanitizer: if parse fails in streaming mode, try splitting on newlines and pick first valid JSON, else append up to 4 closing braces and retry. low risk and reversible.

liu: long-term: instrument pack_bits in quant path and runtime stream flush so we can see if multi-byte tokens are split across flush boundary. If so, ensure flush aligns to token edges.

anya: I'll open two PRs: sanitizer behind FEATURE_STREAM_HEALER and token-boundary logging. kicking off a 50k canary after merge and will report results here.
